description: Count every vowel in your text — per-vowel breakdown, total, and vowel-to-letter ratio, live as you type.

faqs.a: Counts a, e, i, o, u (case-insensitive) and shows each vowel separately plus the total and the share of all letters.
Yes — results update live with every keystroke.
The ratio is vowels ÷ total letters (a–z only), shown as a percentage — typical English is around 38%.

howto: Check the total and vowel ratio.
title: Vowel Counter
